thread:
marie: FYI vendor just sent an ETA update — they can only ship a partial rack allocation this week. 25 racks scheduled -> 17 available now, 8 delayed until next container. This impacts European Dedicated commitments (we had 20 reserved). Need a quick plan for the 3-rack shortfall.

vendor-shipping-bot: Manifest update (shipment 58A): 17 racks loaded, 8 pending. Reason: customs hold on pallet labels. Docs: https://vendor.example.com/shipments/58A 

ashok: Can we pivot 5 racks to cloud marketplace burst credits for EU to cover immediate demand? We can issue credits for missed reserved capacity :thinking_face:

eli: Vendor says 2 pallets mislabelled (ASIN mismatch). The 8 delayed split -> 5 APAC / 3 EU. The 3 EU ones match our committed SKUs — that's the critical gap.

sienna: For the Tue launch we need minimum 2 racks in EU. Ops can soft-shift some canaries to US until we confirm — would prefer credits over rollback.

john-ops: I'll open a routing policy change: temporarily prefer US-region nodes + enable model fallback to smaller instance bundles. ETA to enact: ~30m. Also suggest notifying customers.

marie: Decision proposal: cover the gap with 3 racks from marketplace burst + 2 racks via partner swap for EU, rest queued. @ashok can you confirm marketplace credit approval?

ashok: Confirmed. I'll draft the marketplace credit note and loop legal if needed. Estimated credit ~= 2 weeks of Dedicated delta. Finance signoff maybe needed depending on total $value.

eli: I'll push vendor for expedited customs release on the 3 EU pallets. If not cleared by Mon 09:00 UTC, we trigger fallback and invoice credit.

vendor-shipping-bot: Update 1748501280: customs cleared 2/3 EU pallets, third pallet held for inspection. New ETA for third: 2025-05-02 13:00 UTC.

sienna: Ok — hold canary window until Tue 14:00 UTC. Ops to report readiness by 12:00. If not ready, roll forward with temp US routing.

marie: Action items recap: ashok = marketplace credit + doc; eli = vendor chase + manifest reconciliation; john-ops = routing change + customer comms; sienna = hold canary + confirm. I'll update the partnership tracker.

ashok: Putting note in tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 (credit memo draft).

john-ops: Routing change pushed, request id req-8812, rollback plan in comments.

sienna: CS message draft: 'We may route a subset of EU traffic to US for 6-12 hours to ensure stability. No customer data leaves region.' Review pls.

marie: +1 on wording, add line about credits for affected customers. I'll coordinate with comms. :thumbsup:
